label: Win/Loss Analysis Report
description: Analyzes deal outcomes (wins and losses) to identify patterns, competitive insights, and process improvement opportunities. Produces actionable insights for sales strategy.

guidedInputs.label: Deal outcomes to analyse
guidedInputs.placeholder:
Describe the deals (wins and losses) you want to analyse. For each:
- Deal name or code
- Win or loss
- Deal value
- Competitor (if known)
- Primary reason for outcome (as you understand it)
- Key context (industry, stakeholders, timeline)

Or paste deal data in any format — CRM export, meeting notes, post-mortem summaries.

guidedInputs.label: Overall win rate (if known)
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., 35% win rate, 7 wins out of 20 competitive bids

guidedInputs.label: Competitive landscape
guidedInputs.placeholder: Who are your main competitors? Any known patterns in how you perform against specific competitors?

guidedInputs.label: What are you trying to understand?
